title: Other networks and proof of stake
outcome: Classify the consensus mechanism before describing how a network adds blocks.
show: Make comparison cards for Bitcoin, Monero, and Ethereum mainnet.
concepts: Bitcoin uses proof of work and double SHA-256. Its ASIC tooling and pool interfaces are specific to the job.
Monero uses RandomX, a different proof-of-work algorithm. Bitcoin SHA-256d proofs do not satisfy Monero’s RandomX rules.
Ethereum mainnet switched to proof of stake at The Merge. Its validators propose and attest to blocks under different rules.
replicate: On each card, write consensus, proof or validation role, and source.
Explain why a claim reading ‘mine any cryptocurrency with one miner’ needs to identify the network and algorithm first.
check: Which of the three currently uses proof of stake?
Ethereum mainnet. Bitcoin and Monero use different proof-of-work algorithms.
